context_requirements: Active caspase-dependent apoptosis or caspase-mediated inflammatory signaling at baseline
No strong constitutive apoptotic drive in most immortalized cell lines under normal culture
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of caspase-dependent apoptosis markers (e.g., CASP3, CASP7, PARP1 cleavage signatures) at 6 h or 24 h
Consistent transcriptional changes in apoptosis-related landmark genes across multiple cell lines
Dose-dependent changes in cell viability or apoptosis assays not attributable to vehicle

evidence.supports: Caspase inhibition by DIAP1 is required to block apoptosis-inducing caspase activity, indicating caspase inhibitors act primarily by suppressing apoptosis rather than inducing transcription.
The pan-caspase inhibitor ZVAD-fmk reduced myocardial reperfusion injury and apoptosis in vivo, supporting an anti-apoptotic rather than pro-transcriptional role.
Delayed administration of a pan-caspase inhibitor was neuroprotective, consistent with caspase inhibitors acting on apoptotic execution without a primary transcriptional program.
Q-VD-OPh is a broad-spectrum caspase inhibitor with potent antiapoptotic properties and low toxicity, suggesting minimal direct transcriptional effects.
Emricasan decreased liver injury and apoptosis in a NASH model, supporting caspase inhibitors as anti-apoptotic agents with limited direct transcriptional impact.
